# ankra_proxmox_credential (Resource)

A Proxmox VE API token credential. The counterpart of `ankra credentials proxmox create` and `ankra credentials delete`.

The platform never returns a credential's secrets or connection settings, so a change made to them outside Terraform is not detected; the name, and the credential's existence, are. The token API cannot change a credential in place, so changing a setting replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_proxmox_credential" "lab" {
  name         = "lab"
  api_url      = "https://pve.example:8006"
  token_id     = "root@pam!ankra"
  token_secret = var.proxmox_token_secret

  jumphost = {
    host        = "bastion.example"
    private_key = file("~/.ssh/bastion")
  }

  # Changed or removed in place.
  tailscale = {
    login_server     = "https://headscale.example"
    auth_key         = var.tailscale_auth_key
    advertise_routes = "10.20.0.0/16"
  }
}

variable "proxmox_token_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "tailscale_auth_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_url` (String) Proxmox VE API URL, such as `https://pve.example:8006`. Changing it replaces the credential.
- `name` (String) Credential name, unique per provider in the organisation. Changing it replaces the credential.
- `token_id` (String) API token id, such as `root@pam!ankra`. Changing it replaces the credential.
- `token_secret` (String, Sensitive) API token secret. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Optional

- `internal_api_url` (String) API URL the cluster VMs use to reach Proxmox VE, when it differs from `api_url`. Changing it replaces the credential.
- `jumphost` (Attributes) SSH jumphost the platform tunnels through to reach the API. Changing it replaces the credential. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jumphost))
- `tailscale` (Attributes) Tailscale or Headscale join for the cluster VMs, needed when they sit on a node-local SDN the platform cannot reach otherwise. Changed and removed in place, the counterpart of `ankra credentials proxmox tailscale set|clear`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tailscale))
- `tls_insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification for the API URL. Changing it replaces the credential. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the platform considers the credential usable.
- `created_at` (String) When the credential was created.
- `display_name` (String) Label shown instead of the name in the Ankra portal, when one was set there.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential: the value cluster resources take as `credential_id` or `ssh_key_credential_id`.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state the platform reports, such as `up`.

<a id="nestedatt--jumphost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jumphost`

Required:

- `host` (String) Jumphost address.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) SSH private key for the jumphost.

Optional:

- `port` (Number) Jumphost SSH port. Defaults to `22`.
- `username` (String) Jumphost SSH user. Defaults to `root`.


<a id="nestedatt--tailscale"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tailscale`

Required:

- `auth_key` (String, Sensitive) Pre-authentication key the VMs join with.
- `login_server` (String) Headscale or Tailscale control server URL.

Optional:

- `accept_routes` (Boolean) Accept subnet routes advertised on the tailnet. Defaults to `false`.
- `advertise_routes` (String) Comma-separated CIDRs the VMs advertise to the tailnet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Credentials are imported by id. The platform never returns a credential's secrets,
# so the first apply after an import adopts the configured values without replacing it.
terraform import ankra_proxmox_credential.lab 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
